idea-plugin.name: LionCPH
idea-plugin.description:
LionCPH brings the speed and workflow of VS Code's Competitive Programming Helper (CPH) natively to CLion.

  • Instant Compile, Judge & Debug: Parallel testcase execution, smart compile caching, One-Click Debug TC in CLion Debugger, Sanitizers (ASan/UBSan + MinGW STL debug fallback), Memory (MB/KB) & MLE tracking, signal diagnostics, and side-by-side Colored Visual Diff.
  • Full Codeforces Hub: Ultra-fast Live Verdicts (with Group API Key/Secret support), in-IDE CF Submissions & Upcoming Contests, smart Prev / Standings / Next navigator with automatic end-of-sheet detection, and dual-mode Smart Submit.
  • Smart Workspace Organizer & Template Editor: Automatically organizes problems into Groups/<Group>/<Sheet>, Contests, EDU, Gym, or Practice folders with isolated CMake auto-sync and customizable C++ templates.
  • Competitive Companion & Custom Checker: Auto-imports from 100+ judges on ports 27121 & 10045, Python Special Judge support, and one-click ONLINE_JUDGE / LOCAL macro syncing.

Credits & Special Thanks: Created by Mostafa Musameh, with sincere thanks to Tariq Khalid (@Tariq4824) — QA & Testing Contributor — for his dedicated testing, bug reports, and thoughtful feedback.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.9.2: Safe red Trash button — offers Clear Results Only (keeps all testcases) or Delete Problem with an automatic backup and a 1-click Restore Deleted Problem button so testcases are never accidentally lost.
  • 1.9.1: Pinned sticky bottom Control Dock (+ New Testcase, Submit, Judge Options, 3x3 Tools Grid, Note, and Run All) right at the bottom of the panel so the center zone is dedicated purely to scrolling testcases with zero empty dead space.
  • 1.9.0: Minimalist JetBrains-grade UI polish — consolidated Judge Options (ONLINE_JUDGE, Sanitizers, Float Tolerance, and calmed Custom Checker) into a single sleek collapsible bar with live status summary, trimmed the sticky header, softened card borders, and added subtle placeholder styling to Problem Notes.
  • 1.8.6: Smart Auto Float Tolerance (automatically detects precision from problem statements & decimal sample outputs, plus full user control: Auto / Exact / 1e-4 / 1e-6 / 1e-9 / Custom), and dynamic visual state for the Stopwatch Reset button (dimmed at 00:00, amber while running, bright when paused with elapsed time).
  • 1.8.5: Fixed Codeforces Group name detection — extracts the real group name from the Codeforces sidebar link (/group/<id>) and ignores generic Contests page titles.
  • 1.8.4: Responsive narrow-sidebar polish — fixed overlapping timer & navigation buttons via GridBag/Grid layouts, fixed clipped Sanitizers & Float Tolerance controls, pinned the Open Problem web icon left of the title, and tightened 3x3 grid labels so nothing truncates with ....
  • 1.8.3: Fixed IntelliJ/CLion 2026.3 strict threading exception (Access is allowed from write thread only) when clicking Organize or Rename Group Folder by switching VFS refreshes to asynchronous mode.
  • 1.8.2: Smart Group ID resolution (maps MWSDmqGsZm to ICPC_Assiut_University_Community and auto-fetches real names for any Codeforces Group), fixes split sheet folders under Groups/, adds one-click Rename Group Folder, and recursively cleans/re-sorts existing folders on Organize.
  • 1.8.1: Real-time Codeforces Live & Virtual Contest Timer Sync (uses server-relative epoch timestamps for zero drift), fixed timer button text truncation (dynamic width), and dedicated Problemset/ + cleaner Groups/<Group>/<Sheet> & Contests/<Contest> folder organization.
  • 1.8.0: Major Competitive Programming Upgrade — added Dual Sticky Timer (per-problem Stopwatch with auto-pause on AC + Contest/Virtual/Sheet Countdown), Float Tolerance comparison (Exact / 1e-6 / 1e-9), Pre-Submit Safety Guard (freopen / endl / debug check), CP Snippets Library (insert DSU, SegTree, Sieve, Dijkstra & custom templates at cursor), Batch .in/.out Folder Importer, quick Problem Notes for upsolving, and crystal-clear 3x3 button labels.
  • 1.7.6: Pinned sticky top header (problem title, Open Problem, Collapse All, passed counter, folder breadcrumb, and Codeforces Prev/Standings/Next bar) so key controls stay visible while scrolling large testcase lists.
  • 1.7.5: Redesigned 3x3 action grid with zero duplicate buttons (added Set URL, one-click Organize, GitHub, and About), instant Codeforces navigation refresh when editing problem URLs, safer cross-drive file moving in Workspace Organizer, and a cleaner Settings dialog.
  • 1.7.4: Clearer labeled navigation buttons (Prev / Standings / Next / Last Problem), automatic end-of-sheet detection (never creates bogus files past the last problem), and zero duplicate tabs on existing files.
  • 1.7.3: Smart tab-spam prevention on Prev/Next navigation (existing local files open directly in CLion without duplicating browser tabs; new problems open once automatically) plus a quick Open Problem icon right beside the problem title.
  • 1.7.2: Smart Workspace Organizer (3 modes: Flat, Single Folder, or Smart Hierarchy for Groups/Sheets, Contests, EDU, Gym, Practice, AtCoder/CSES), Short vs. Full file naming style, live folder breadcrumb, unique subfolder CMake target naming, and one-click Organize Existing Root Files.
  • 1.7.1: Added one-click Collapse All / Expand All toggle in the header, fixed Custom Checker box clipping & chevron direction, and added scrollable Compilation Error panel with one-click Copy.
  • 1.7.0: Dedicated C++ Template Editor, optional Contest/Sheet/Practice auto-folder organization (with full CMake support), Memory usage (MB/KB) & MLE diagnostics, refined sleek navigation bar (zero duplicate buttons), and tuned 2x smooth mouse-wheel scrolling.
  • 1.6.4: 3x faster & smoother mouse-wheel scrolling across large testcase lists, and automatic Codeforces API fallback with clear error diagnostics.
  • 1.6.3: Modern refined dark UI with rounded cards and cleaner navigation bar, plus auto-create & sample testcase fetching when clicking Next/Prev problem.
  • 1.6.2: Full Codeforces Hub inside CLion — in-IDE CF Submissions table, Upcoming Contests countdown viewer, one-click Standings, and ultra-fast (~1.1s) smart-backoff Live Verdicts with Group API Key/Secret support.
  • 1.6.1: Smart Codeforces Problem Navigator (Prev / Next problem in CLion & browser with automatic Last Problem detection, one-click My Submissions), plus fast 2-second authenticated Live Verdicts supporting Codeforces Groups (API Key & Secret).
  • 1.6.0: Universal CLion compatibility (2024.2 – 2026.3+, Classic & Nova), One-Click Debug TC in CLion Debugger, Sanitizers toggle (ASan/UBSan + MinGW STL debug fallback), side-by-side Colored Visual Diff, and Live Codeforces Verdicts inside CLion.
  • 1.5.3: Fixed cph-submit idle polling (returns HTTP 404 when no submission is queued) to guarantee zero unintended browser tabs.
  • 1.5.2: Full resource & thread-pool hygiene, multi-window CLion support, Stop button for single-test runs, Gson upgrade safety, Codeforces EDU support, and hardened CMake GLOB detection.
  • 1.4.x: Pixel-faithful CPH UI, instant trash delete, isolated CMake auto-sync with reload, and dual-mode smart Codeforces Submit (with cph-submit IPv6/IPv4 support).
